run_adsorbml_pipeline: run the AdsorbML pipeline to identify global minima adsorption energy for slab-adsorbate systems
calculate_adsorption_energies: calculate adsorption energies for a chunk of slab-adsorbate systems using an ASE calculator
write_adsorbml_results: write AdsorbML calculation results to a compressed JSON file in the results directory
initialize_adsorbml_runner: initialize an AdsorbMLRunner with an ASE calculator, input data path, and relaxation parameters
save_adsorbml_state: save the AdsorbMLRunner checkpoint state to a specified location for preemption recovery
